reconcile.note: Matthew Henry treats the two mantle scenes as one continuous calling, with Elijah keeping the cloak intact until it fell to Elisha at the ascension.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells presses the timing as a genuine conflict, since Elijah casts the mantle on Elisha at their first meeting yet Elisha only picks it up after the ascension.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: Elijah passed over to him, and cast his mantle on him.
sides.verseText: So he departed there, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing, with twelve yoke [of oxen] before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed over to him, and cast his mantle on him.

sides.snippet: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him
sides.verseText: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of the Jordan.
